description: This file defines the MockHandler class used for testing AWS SDK interactions by simulating responses and exceptions. It manages a queue of results or exceptions, handles invoking these responses, and provides methods to append new responses or exceptions, as well as retrieve information about the last request and command.

classes.name: MockHandler
classes.description: A mock handler for AWS SDK that simulates responses and exceptions using a queue for testing purposes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the mock handler with an optional queue of results and callbacks for fulfilled and rejected promises.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds one or more ResultInterface or Exception objects to the queue.

methods.name: appendException
methods.description: Adds one or more Exception or Throwable objects to the queue.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles a command and request, returning a promise that resolves or rejects based on the queued responses.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of remaining items in the queue.
